text:
Erica: Quick follow-up from today's infra all-hands. Wanted a short live thread for outstanding GPU/region/autoscale questions. Drop quick clarifications.
Sam: High level: we have two parallel tracks — short-term capacity (reserve A100 slots, refactor autoscaler rules) and longer-term H100 onboarding (Q3).
Jasmine: Any ETA on H100 readiness for Dedicated? We have 2 customers asking about perf and quantization.
Vikram: Targeting H100 for Dedicated in early Q3 but onboarding depends on kernel validation. We'll publish perf numbers (latency/throughput) as soon as nightly runs pass.
Lina: Is there a plan for cross-region failover if APAC faces shortages? e.g., spillover to EU with TTL-based routing?
Sam: Yes 10 we plan region spillover with latency-aware weighting. Default TTL on cross-region is 2s for soft-fail routing, with a hard-fail fallback after 5s.
Erica: How will pricing/workflow look when we spill to a more expensive region?
Vikram: Billing will annotate cross-region usage; for Hosted we'll absorb soft-fail spill for short bursts, and surface alerts for persistent cross-region serving. Dedicated customers can opt-in to auto-failover or require manual approval.
Jasmine: Autoscaler: any change to scale-down aggressiveness? We had noisy short spikes that killed small pipelines.
Sam: Proposed change: introduce a "burst buffer" (small token bucket) so short spikes are absorbed without scaling events. Scale-down still uses exponential backoff: 5m -> 10m -> 20m windows.
Lina: Can we see the autoscaler proposal config? A snippet would help ops and platform to review.
Vikram: Paste of draft config:
```
scale_policy:
  type: utilization
  target_util: 0.65
  burst_buffer_ms: 30000
  scale_down_windows: [300, 600, 1200]
  cooldown_base: 90
  cooldown_mode: adaptive
```
Sam: Note: burst_buffer_ms absorbs ~95% of 1-10s spikes in our sim. Needs more runs for mixed short/long seqs.
Jasmine: What telemetry will we expose so customers understand when they're on fallback models/regions?
Vikram: UI/console will show a "serving region" badge, plus per-request metadata in trace logs (region, model_variant, fallback_reason). We'll add a dashboard tile for cross-region percent.
Erica: Any procurement risk flags we should be aware of?
Sam: Short: APAC cloud quotas + H100 lead times. We're negotiating committed pools with two providers to reduce spot volatility.
Lina: Who should teams ping for an urgent temporary capacity bump (e.g., promo day)?
Vikram: Pager duty: infra-capacity-oncall. For scheduled promos use the capacity-request form (link in #eng-sre pinned).
deploy-bot: :rocket: Deployed autoscaler experiment to staging - id=as-exp-17. Logs: https://logs.internal/exp/as-exp-17
Jasmine: Can QA run a 48h soak in staging with the burst buffer on? I'll coordinate infra tests.
Sam: Please do. Jasmine, tag me and we'll reserve extra test slots.
Erica: Action items: Sam to share procurement SLA notes; Vikram to open PR with autoscaler config and simulation results; Jasmine to run 48h soak and report; Lina to draft cross-region failover playbook. We'll reconvene next week.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Recorded actions: sam/procurement-note, vikram/autoscaler-pr, jasmine/soak, lina/playbook
Sam: Thanks all, appreciate quick responses.
